store.name: Clay and Tide
store.tagline: A set made from your own roll
store.about: Your roll keeps returning to the wheel, the morning cup and the walk along the cliffs. These are pieces to wear and live with.

products.title: Thrown Cup Ring
products.prompt: Ring in sterling silver: a 6 mm wide band with a soft ridged surface like the throwing lines on a wheel-made cup, comfort fit, satin finish. No stones, no engraving, no text.
products.why: Hand-thrown ceramics are in 41% of your moments, more than any other idea in your photos.

products.title: Pour-Over Drop
products.prompt: Pendant necklace in sterling silver: a 22 mm teardrop with a small open cone at its centre, like a pour-over dripper seen from above, polished edge, matte face, on an 18 in chain. No stones, no text.
products.why: A morning coffee ritual shows up in 37% of your moments.

products.title: Tide Pool Rug
products.prompt: Printed area rug, 5x8 ft, low pile: irregular rounded pools of sea glass and oat on a charcoal ground, like tide pools seen from a cliff, shapes at least 8 inches across. Flat printed pattern, no fringe, no text.
products.why: Coastal walks are in 29% of your moments.

products.title: Pressed Stems
products.prompt: Wall art print, 11x14 in, matte paper: three pressed flower stems as soft silhouettes in dusty rose and clay on an oat ground, wide margins. No text.
products.why: Dried flowers appear in 18% of your moments.

products.title: Market Cloth Pillow
products.prompt: Printed throw pillow, 20x20 in: a loose check of oat and clay with a thin charcoal line, like a market tablecloth, flat print on a linen-look cover, hidden zip. No text.
products.why: Slow weekend markets are in 16% of your moments, and linen and natural textures in 14%.
